note:
STRIPPING A COMMENT CAN REFLOW THE CONSTRUCT IT SAT IN. 23079 -> 23101, and every one of the 22 is prettier/prettier.

Removing all Python and JS comments across 14 modules took 5053 JS comments out. A comment inside a multi-line array, object or argument list is the only thing keeping prettier from collapsing that construct onto one line; take it away and prettier reports the construct it can now join. The 22 are that, in ten files -- documents/views/helper/* and documents/static/tests/details_panel.test.js hold most of them.

No other rule moved. An earlier cut of the same change measured +134: +131 prettier from blank-line handling (a comment sitting between two blank lines left two in a row, which prettier rejects), +2 no-empty (a catch block whose only content was the comment), +1 no-fallthrough (eslint reads `// falls through` as the explicit marker). The stripper now takes one adjacent blank line with a whole-line comment, keeps a comment that is the sole content of an empty block, and treats the fallthrough marker as a directive. Those 112 units are fixed, not banked.

tsc did not move: 1906 before and after, 0 new and 0 gone against the error list. JSDoc type tags, @import, @template and the semantic modifiers (@private and friends) are preserved, so the type surface is unchanged. jsduplication, jsvacuous, jsprivate, jsserviceshape, jsforcedrender and all five jsfunclen floors are likewise unmoved.
